pages.text: “A delightful blend of sweet and tart, adding joy to the journey.”$(br2)Sweet Berries Tea is a refreshing and subtly sweet beverage made from dried sweet berries, blended with sugar to enhance its flavor. Drinking it provides brief health regeneration, offering a moment of relief for weary travelers.
$(br2)$(br)To prepare Sweet Berries Tea, $(br)mix three portions of dried sweet berries with sugar.$(br)It is best consumed during travels, providing gentle health restoration for explorers.

Upon drinking Sweet Berries Tea, travelers gain a short-term health regeneration effect, allowing for gradual recovery on their journey.$(br)This is a sweet and practical tea, perfect for replenishing energy between exploration and battles.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
